description: Intake gate whitelist: manually maintained collection of pre-approved submitters. Matched entries skip identity and account-age checks (blacklist checks are never exempted).
description_zh: 入闸白名单：管理人员手动采集提交通道。命中者跳过身份与注册时长检查（黑名单检查不豁免）。

users.note: Sim public-repo owner: runs triggered by dispatcher/cron fall back to repository_owner for identity verification at the gate, so the sim/formal public-repo owner must be whitelisted or all submissions are rejected
users.note_zh: 模拟公开仓 owner：dispatcher/cron 触发的 run 由 gate 回退到 repository_owner 核验身份，模拟/正式公开仓 owner 必须在白名单内，否则全量拒收
